snippet.title: Livin' the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator - Trailer
snippet.description:
A little shop, a world of flavors. Available on Steam from November 3rd 2026!🍦

Make ice cream, discover new recipes, and create a shop that’s entirely your own in Livin’ the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator.

Scoop your favorite flavors, swirl soft serve, pile on the toppings, and serve customers in a colorful Caribbean setting. Complete tasks and unlock skill upgrades to expand your menu, then make the place yours with equipment and decorations in different styles and colors.

Settle into relaxed Cozy mode or take on the time-management challenge of Classic mode. Your shop, your pace, your signature scoop.

🍨 Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4621810/

🎮 Play the free demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5100290/

💬 Join the official Discord:
https://discord.gg/aBKPygmuwJ

📰 Press kit:
https://ritual-interactive.com/ltcpresskit/

Developed by Clover Rock Games.
Published by Ritual Interactive.
